title: Sad Violin
blurb: The sad violin — the melodramatic string melody that plays when something mildly unfortunate gets treated like a Shakespearean tragedy. The meme version, specifically: it's for dropped ice cream cones, missed buses, and gamers dying to the easiest enemy. Maximum pathos applied to minimum stakes. A cornerstone of ironic editing since the YouTube montage era.
origin: The classic ironic-tragedy backing track from the YouTube montage era.
